lina_cs: Morning — AeroCart weekly health snapshot. Quick summary: error rate spiked this week during their ingestion runs. Need rapid triage; renewal AM check in 48h so flagging.

Key 7d vs prior 7d:
- overall error-rate: 2.1% -> 7.3%
- 5xx server errors: 0.6% -> 4.0% (net +3.4pp)
- gateway timeouts: x3 (most on /internal/prefix-lookup)
- 429s (rate limit): 0.2% -> 2.2% (burst patterns from embeddings calls)
- spend: slight bump due to retries but still within committed tier

Top failing endpoints (last 24h):
1) POST /api/v1/complete 
 - 61% of 5xx, many 503/500s during heavy context loads, p95 latency 1.5s
2) POST /api/v1/stream 
 - long-lived connections dropping with socket resets -> client retries, amplifying load
3) POST /api/v1/embeddings 
 - 429s on burst, ~40% of errors are rate limits
4) GET /internal/prefix-lookup 
 - timeouts when their prefix index is large

Context: AeroCart started a nightly reindex and large batch evaluation two days ago; traffic bursts correlate. They run on dedicated pool dc-3.

infra-bot: ALERT: aero-453 (AeroCart) 5xx threshold breached for 18m. https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-2135002468

devin_se: Looking at logs. Quick snippet from 2026-03-19T18:04:02Z:
```
[2026-03-19T18:04:02Z] worker: inference-12 ERR: allocation failure, cannot reserve 1.2GB (heap)
[2026-03-19T18:04:02Z] proxy: upstream reset by peer for /api/v1/stream (req=xyz123)
[2026-03-19T18:04:03Z] gateway: deadline exceeded after 12s for /internal/prefix-lookup (req=xyz124)
[2026-03-19T18:04:04Z] quota: applied 429 -> /api/v1/embeddings (burst throttle)
```

devin_se: Hypothesis: combination of memory pressure on large v-model instances + amplified retries from clients holding streaming connections -> file descriptor / socket exhaustion and cascading 5xx/timeouts.

harry_eng: Agree. Proposed quick mitigations:
- enable per-tenant conn_limit (drop long idle streams after 30s)
- temporarily throttle embeddings to 15 rps for aero-453
- move their generate/stream traffic to a separate smaller instance class (z-small-q4) to avoid OOMs
- return a Retry-After header on 429s so clients back off instead of immediate retry

Commands I can run now:
```
rwctl quota set --customer aero-453 --route /api/v1/embeddings --rps 15 --duration 2h
rwctl routing set --customer aero-453 --route /api/v1/complete --fallback z-small-q4 --duration 2h
rwctl connlimit set --customer aero-453 --route /api/v1/stream --idle-timeout 30s\```

harry_eng: Also will flip a kernel-level fd soft-limit bump on dc-3 for 30m to buy headroom.

nate_success: Ill message AeroCart engineering immediately and ask them to pause the nightly reindex for 2 hours and to apply client-side exponential backoff for streaming retries. I can provide a sample curl + backoff snippet.

ops-bot: NOTE: Incident INC-2135002468 mitigation actions applied: routing fallback + quota throttle + connlimit. Monitoring for 30m.

devin_se: After applying the throttles and connlimit, initial metrics show 5xx down from 4.0% -> 2.2% within 12m and 429s stable at ~1.0%. Will continue to monitor.

lina_cs: Thanks all. Nate, please include a short blurb for the renewal thread: "mitigated - monitoring, next update in 24h". If metrics regress we escalate.

nate_success: Done 44d I'll keep the customer updated and note this in renewal doc.

lina_cs: Closing for now. Follow-up items: 1) get post-mortem of why their reindex caused such large prefix lookups, 2) recommend client-side backoff + cache hints, 3) consider long-term quota bump if they remain on dedicated pool.
